test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question: The term “RUDRA” was in the news on the eve of the Republic Day Parade 2026. What does RUDRA refer to?

options.text: An integration of surface-to-surface system cruise missile system and drones
An AI-integrated Ghatak Unmanned Combat Aerial Vehicle (UCAV) program
A next-generation high altitude light mechanised-infantry combat vehicle
India’s first fully integrated self-contained all-arms combat brigade

solution:
The correct answer is __**India’s first fully integrated self-contained all-arms combat brigade.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **RUDRA was highlighted during the Republic Day Parade 2026 as India’s first fully integrated all-arms combat brigade.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **RUDRA is a self-contained, integrated combat formation designed to operate independently like a mini-army.**
 
• **I**t integrates armour, mechanised infantry, artillery, air defence, engineers, drones, electronic warfare and special forces.
 
• The formation has inbuilt logistics, ammunition supply, fuel and field hospitals.
 
• RUDRA enables rapid, networked and high-intensity multi-domain operations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **All-arms brigade** combines multiple combat and support arms under a single command structure.
 
• **Multi-domain warfare** involves coordinated operations across land, air, cyber, space and electronic domains.
 
• **Decade of Transformation** is the Indian Army’s modernisation initiative focusing on agility and integration.
 
• **Republic Day Parade** showcases India’s latest military doctrines, capabilities and indigenous systems.
